card.title: 5th PARACHUTE BRIGADE
card.flavorText: The 5th Parachute Brigade was raised by the British Army during WWII, and along with the 3rd Parachute and the 6th Airlanding Brigade it was assigned to the 6th Airborne Division. The brigade participated in their first airborne operation in June 1944, Operation Tonga, which was part of Operation Overlord and the D-Day landings in Normandy. The next engagement the 5th Brigade participated in was during the Battle of the Bulge, which was followed by Operation Varsity, a successful airborne operation over Germany and the last Allied airborne operation during WWII. When the war ended the brigade was involved in disarming Japanese forces in South Asia before rejoining the 6th Airborne Division in Palestine where the brigade was disbanded in late 1945.
